title: FGFBP2 p.T186S mutation in tumor associated fibroblasts supports progression of pancreatic cancer through autocrine and paracrine mechanisms.
snippet: Pancreatic cancer is one of the most aggressive human tumors with an extremely poor prognosis. title: Pathway Activity-Based Prognostic Risk Score Associated with Cisplatin Sensitivity in Small Cell Lung Cancer: Multi-Cohort Validation and Mechanistic Analysis.
snippet: Small Cell Lung Cancer (SCLC), also referred to as small cell lung carcinoma, is a highly aggressive malignancy with a strong propensity for early metastasis. Platinum-based regimens are widely used as first-line chemotherapy; however, most patients relapse within one year, develop platinum resistance, and have poor outcomes.
